subject: Stitch & handoff — MSA/DPA sequencing, milestone owners and gating
messages:
From: Erin Cole <erin.cole@vitahealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Stitch: sequencing MSA/DPA + milestone owners

Jasmine / Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. Before legal and procurement lock a date for the pilot, Procurement needs a short mutual action plan that shows dependencies, owners, and an expected close window for the MSA + DPA + order form. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm which items must complete before PO / order form signature (security review, DPA redlines, SOC 2 evidence).
- Proposed owner for each task (Redwood rep vs VitaHealth).
- Target dates for each milestone — VitaHealth is aiming to sign by end of May but needs clarity on gating.

I attached our internal MAP workbook to show the structure we usually use. Can your legal and sales ops teams sketch a single-column sequencing view (who does what, when) so we can line that up with Procurement?

Attachment: VitaHealth_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 98KB)

Samir (VitaHealth legal) is looped below for any contractual constraints. Can you let us know availability for a 30-min alignment call next week? Prefer morning PT.

Thanks,
Erin Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
VitaHealth
Erin.Cole@vitahealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@vitahealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stitch: sequencing MSA/DPA + milestone owners

Erin — appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a concise sequencing view from our side (redwood-proposed-map-v1.xlsx) and a working DPA draft for initial review. Key points up front:

- Target close window: we can realistically reach signature by 2025-05-28 if we follow the milestones below and keep redlines to a 3-business-day turnaround.
- Must-complete before PO: signed MSA + DPA (exceptions require an internal SLA exception), completed security questionnaire and SOC 2 evidence exchange.
- Parallel work: procurement can prepare the order form while legal finalizes redlines; finance needs the order form 5 business days before PO issuance.

Proposed milestone owners and dates (high level):
- Kickoff & MAP alignment call — Responsible: Erin (VitaHealth) + Jasmine (Redwood) — Target: 2025-04-22
- Security questionnaire completion — Responsible: VitaHealth (data controls) + Redwood (evidence) — Target: 2025-04-29
- Legal redline window (DPA/MAA) — Responsible: VitaHealth legal (Samir) + Redwood legal (Laura) — Target: initial redlines back by 2025-05-06
- Order form draft & pricing reconciliation — Responsible: VitaHealth procurement + Redwood sales ops (Marcus) — Target: 2025-05-12
- Final sign & PO issuance — Responsible: VitaHealth procurement + Redwood finance — Target: 2025-05-28

If that sequencing works we should calendar the kickoff and a weekly 30-min sync (Wednesdays) to track blockers.

Attachments: redwood-proposed-map-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB); Redwood_DPA-draft-v2.pdf (pdf, 45KB)

— Jasmine Liu
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Erin Cole <erin.cole@vitahealth.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 19 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stitch: sequencing MSA/DPA + milestone owners

Folks — quick legal sequencing notes after reviewing the draft DPA Jasmine attached:

1) Redline cadence: Redwood legal can turn around initial comments in 2 business days once we have VitaHealth's redlines. To keep the May 28 target, VitaHealth legal should aim to return redlines by 2025-05-06 (as Jasmine suggested).

2) SOC 2 / evidence: we can supply a SOC 2 report and supplementary SOC evidence links by 2025-04-25; that should satisfy the typical supplier checklist. If VitaHealth requires an in-depth control narrative, that may add 1 week.

3) DPA specifics: the biggest negotiation areas historically are data residency clauses, subprocessors, and breach notification timelines. If Samir can flag must-have language now we can prepare a limited-redline path (i.e., non-negotiables first) to accelerate sign-off.

4) Order form gating: finance needs the agreed pricing and billing cadence before final signature. Marcus — if you can provide a short price-breakdown table to include in the order form by 2025-05-09, that will buy us time for legal.

5) Risk-based fallback: suggest we propose a limited pilot SOW in the order form that permits go-live on a scoped set of endpoints while full DPA is finalized under an executed letter agreement. Samir — is that acceptable to VitaHealth procurement/legal as a contingency?

Attachment references: Redwood_DPA-draft-v2.pdf (see Section 3.2 and 6.1 for notification windows).

Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2025 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stitch: sequencing MSA/DPA + milestone owners — action items

Erin / Samir — quick operational note and owners list so we have a single checklist for the kickoff. Happy to take point on orchestration between sales, legal and finance. Action items:

- Calendar: Jasmine / Erin to run kickoff 2025-04-22 09:30 PT (30m) — invite sent.
- Security evidence: Redwood to upload SOC 2 and control attachments to shared Drive by 2025-04-25 — owner: Marcus (Redwood).
- DPA redline path: VitaHealth to provide initial comments by 2025-05-06 — owner: Samir (VitaHealth legal).
- Pricing table for order form: Marcus to share price-breakdown by 2025-05-09 — owner: Marcus (Redwood sales ops).
- Order form draft: Redwood to produce a fillable order form template the week of 2025-05-05 for VitaHealth to review — owner: Jasmine (Redwood).
- Contingency pilot SOW (limited endpoints): Redwood to prepare a 30-day pilot SOW option to allow limited launch pending final DPA — owner: Jasmine — deliver by 2025-05-12.

If any of those dates are tight on your side please flag. We'll use the weekly Wednesday 30-min sync to escalate blockers; I suggest we keep the Jira ticket for legal redlines (SUP-4021) open and link all artifacts there.

Thanks — see you at the kickoff.
Karthik Iyer
Director, Contracts & Partner Ops
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
